amendment: new version + reason + exposure log + fresh future evaluation; never rewrite existing artifacts
baseline: action-conditioned empirical quantiles and Laplace classes

calendar.anchor: future UTC midnight, after inherited holdout end; bind before any new collection
calendar.scope: new independent prospective sampling plan; D43/D45 calendars cannot satisfy F01

claim: forecast skill only within fixed observed cohort and conditional snapshot label support; no trading edge

evaluation.boundary: bootstrap never bridges missing calendar days or separate folds
evaluation.holdout_support: same per-action support/censoring and >=24 observed days, checked only after formal release
evaluation.hypothesis_family: two comparators, family alpha0.05 via two 97.5 percent intervals
evaluation.masks: return only observed roundtrip; class only observed status; censored never zero labels
evaluation.primary: paired daily normalized joint proper-loss improvement vs empirical AND linear
evaluation.repeated_looks: no repeated holdout peeking, optional stopping or extension after scores
evaluation.result: improved only if both lower bounds >2 percent, precision/calibration guards pass; else inconclusive/no improvement
evaluation.weighting: equal scenarios within decision, equal decisions within pool/day, equal pools then UTC days

feature_contract.normalization: unique train frames only; masks retained

inherited_holdout.policy: quarantine entire intersecting window; no label release

selection.ensemble: mean ordered quantiles and mean probabilities across three seeds, never best seed
selection.epoch: earliest best validation epoch per seed; final refit uses median of selected epochs
selection.final: same frozen selection procedure on days49..56; refit chosen and linear ensembles on days0..56
selection.outer_test: selected validation policy and empirical/linear comparators only; no retuning
selection.rule: lowest predeclared priority within 1 percent of best; exact zero has no slack

campaign.boundary_policy: reset history; censor every segment tail; never bridge gaps

targets.continuation: exit entire net acquired amount; hold from entry observation publication
targets.entry_sizing: gross wallet input from decision reserve; fixed before future states
targets.impact: integer local quote impact; no persistent own impact or intervening activity
targets.label_definition: conditional on snapshot fills; net of pool/transfer fees only

training.failure: stop experiment on data/NaN/integrity fault; no replacement seeds or tuning retries
training.loss: masked pinball / train return IQR floor1e-4 + masked class cross entropy
training.scale: pooled observed train return IQR only; no validation/test fit
